typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Vendor as string,
		{Outreach Date} as string,
		Modality as string,
		Market as string,
		MarketSegment as string,
		OutreachType as string,
		Memberid as string,
		LastName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		MBR_ADDR1 as string,
		MBR_ADDR2 as string,
		City as string,
		County as string,
		State as string,
		ZipCode as string,
		Phone as string,
		Language as string,
		Email as string,
		Gender as string,
		BirthDate as timestamp,
		Age as integer,
		ProvTaxID as string,
		GroupName as string,
		ProviderId as string,
		ProviderName as string,
		DueDate as string,
		Service as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Vendor = Vendor) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		GroupName as string,
		ProviderId as string,
		Email as string,
		Gender as string,
		MBR_ADDR1 as string,
		MBR_ADDR2 as string,
		County as string,
		MarketSegment as string,
		Language as string,
		Phone as string,
		ProvTaxID as string,
		DueDate as string,
		Age as integer,
		OutreachType as string,
		FirstName as string,
		ZipCode as string,
		Service as string,
		Outreach_Date as string,
		Vendor as string,
		City as string,
		Market as string,
		Memberid as string,
		ProviderName as string,
		State as string,
		LastName as string,
		Modality as string,
		BirthDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		GroupName,
		ProviderId,
		Email,
		Gender,
		MBR_ADDR1,
		MBR_ADDR2,
		County,
		MarketSegment,
		Language,
		Phone,
		ProvTaxID,
		DueDate,
		Age,
		OutreachType,
		FirstName,
		ZipCode,
		Service,
		Outreach_Date = {Outreach Date},
		Vendor,
		City,
		Market,
		Memberid,
		ProviderName,
		State,
		LastName,
		Modality,
		BirthDate)) ~> FlatFileDestination
